surface_name: Tool names across MCP and LLM APIs
title: MCP tool names with dots are valid in MCP but rejected when forwarded to the Claude API
symptoms: 400 invalid_request_error on a tools[].name when a custom client passes MCP tools straight to Claude
A tool such as admin.tools.list works in one MCP client and breaks a home-grown agent
cause: The MCP spec lets tool names use letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, and dot, up to 128 characters. The Claude API requires names to match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$, so a dot fails.
fix: Name tools with letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens only, or map names in the client before sending them to the model and map them back on tool_use.
apply: const safe = (n) => n.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_').slice(0, 128); // keep a map from safe name to original
affected: MCP protocol 2025-11-25 and later tool naming; Claude Messages API tool name pattern, as of 2026-10
